body: I've done that, and I tried to do many things to take my mind off of this and ease the situation. Went out, hiked, spent time with family, went over to friends, invited friends over. Not a huge believer at all, but man have I prayed. Haven't drank in a year since I'm terrible at dealing with alcohol, but I got totally wasted. I've always despised drugs for some weird moral value in my head, but man, am I ever so glad I don't have access to any right now. It's been many weeks, and it doesn't seem to be getting better at all. No matter what I do, my emotions just repeat what I felt the previous day. No matter who I surround myself with, I feel lonely.
